changes.summary: Replace backtracking HTML app-shell detection with DOM inspection and allow isolated reader clients to fail without in-process parsing
Retry owned-index initialization after a transient database outage instead of retaining a rejected initialization promise

Add durable owned web indexes with PostgreSQL crawl leases, versioned evidence, native search-provider integration, authenticated plugins, workers, reviewed entity projections and six-framework clients
Preserve surrounding evidence context, validate quoted wording, support extraction without planning, and adapt isolated single-page readers without mixing source attribution
Protect feed, sitemap and site discovery through final ingestion with bounded public-address transport; enforce robots agent, allow and wildcard rules and abort on temporary robots failures.
Republish the tested research quality improvements as 0.20.0 because npm has not made 0.19.0 installable.
Allow a separately configured review provider and model through the existing host accounting path.

Require relevance, entity, time and scope checks before supporting research fields; carry task criteria into review, bound default findings and share evidence space with follow-up sources. Resolve model-selected passage IDs to exact source text instead of asking models to transcribe quotes.
Accept Elysia 2 and TypeBox 1 research schemas with inferred result types and matching runtime validation while preserving TypeBox 0.34 compatibility.

Add configurable web research, bounded multistep planning, field-level evidence review, a server plugin and six framework flows, company discovery, resumable batches, fenced PostgreSQL monitoring, billing admission, agent tools and evaluation adapters.
Reuse shared pinned transport and add a typed remote website-reader client with caller cancellation and reserved fallback time
Reject additional reserved IPv6 ranges through the shared public-address validator
Add page-by-page PDF extraction with OCR for image-bearing pages, preserving mixed-document evidence and rejecting incomplete extraction.
Decode real PDFs with PDF.js, preserving page evidence across compressed streams and font encodings without application intake caps; retain explicit OCR support.
Preserve all sections of public websites instead of extracting one article fragment, and retain labeled image evidence in source-bound documents.
Expose bounded website documents bound to source IDs and compact inline citation links for native MCP evidence presentation.
Require nearby source links for factual answers and distinguish supported customer examples from unsupported exclusions, ownership relationships and rebrand history.
Return copy-ready source citations before website evidence and repeat links beside each retrieved page; exclude failed reads and unread links from the source list.
Balance repeated customer, service and company reads across an eight-page default budget (maximum twelve) with 48000 characters, preventing case-study archives from starving service details.
Expose stop reasons and actual incomplete page reads separately from unvisited links; guide targeted continuation and concise nontechnical answers.
Add bounded multi-page website research with exact page citations, semantic links and image labels, media and caption evidence, redirect chains and explicit coverage limits.
Expand website result and renderer contracts with semantic evidence, redirect hops and explicit readiness/coverage metadata; existing renderers may omit the new optional renderer fields.
Honor HTML response MIME types for extensionless URL ingestion instead of treating website markup as plain text, including XHTML and batch URL loading.

Add a bounded public website reader with prepared evidence, per-attempt diagnostics, automatic JavaScript rendering through an optional Playwright adapter, isolated browser contexts and DNS-pinned public-only resource fetching.
Encode retrieved original-text passages as request-scoped quote references and restore exact quotes without rewriting source text
Accept AI 0.2 alongside existing compatible AI releases; validate retrieval against AI 0.2.0
Forward AI context policy through RAG WebSocket and SSE chat; accept the next AI 0.1 release while retaining compatibility with the prior AI peer range
Allow servers to request a smaller original-source search result set while preserving candidate ranking, authorization, and exact token budgeting
Count a complete authorized source-result envelope once when it fits, avoiding serial tokenizer round trips while retaining exact budget validation and oversized-result packing
Add verbatim versioned text ingestion and authorized hybrid source tools with caller-supplied model token budgets; preserve multilingual keyword matches

migration.instruction: Use a store implementing queryLexical for lexical/hybrid retrieval, or explicitly select vector mode on vector-only stores. Scoped heuristic queries now retain the requested channels; update trace consumers from Scoped direct route to Scoped retrieval route.

changes.summary: Reject unsupported lexical and hybrid retrieval instead of silently omitting keyword results; preserve requested channels for scoped heuristic queries
